
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- wrong_pin_method.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- TYPE MISMATCH -- wrong_pin_method.volt:7[/red bold]

Type `Output` has no method `read`.

 [dim]6 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]7 |[/dim]     led.read()
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]    ^^^[/red]
